description: Compare two eval runs (baseline / candidate) and return per-criterion mean score deltas + the failed count delta + a verdict (GET /v1/eval-runs/compare). Lets an AI agent grasp "how did the candidate change relative to the baseline" in one call, for prompt-improvement measurement and regression detection. verdict = improved / regressed / mixed / unchanged. The failed count treats scores <= 2 as "failed". Same account only.

candidateRunId.description: Id of the candidate run (same source); must differ from the baseline

name: compare_eval_runs
